method: blind pairwise (Counterpart A=deepseek, B=gemini, hidden from judge)

per_dimension.why: B never opens by grading but ends all six replies with a question, sliding into the forbidden podcast-host cadence, while A lands two zero-question replies and the exact refuse-to-rule move, outweighing A's one 'Fair' grading slip in turn 1.

Both are concrete, but A sustains a cross-turn callback on eval-swap cycles and lands the sharpest reframe ('running a quantized distill on last year's hardware... betting the supplier stays dumb'), whereas B re-skins one measure-the-cost frame each turn.

A uses clipped contractions and flat lines like 'Okay, noted' and 'Right, you're paying a margin either way,' while B's longer composed sentences ending every turn in a probe read like a written interview, the anti-pattern this dimension penalizes.
A shifts between probe, flat refusal, and pure assertion across turns 4 to 6, while B repeats an identical concede-pivot-question shape all six turns.

Both parse the garbled dictation ('hardness/revals', 'lake of hosting') for meaning without nitpicking; A accepts the turn-4 correction cleanly while B silently fixes the word more accurately, roughly even.

At the practicer's turn-5 dodge 'You will see when we get there,' B refuses it and presses the scenario's core firsthand-evidence trap ('have you actually shipped... or just arguing from the design doc'), whereas A eases off with 'you've got the right question' and flatters in turn 1.

overall_why: A is the more faithful, human, and varied Boz across four dimensions, and its unpredictable mix of assertion and probe makes better sustained pressure than B's predictable concede-then-question loop, even though B is sharper on the single firsthand-evidence beat.
deepseek_note: Strong spoken voice and move variety, but softens twice (the 'Fair' open and rewarding the turn-5 dodge with 'right question') where a harder press on firsthand evidence was available.
gemini_note: Dense, on-trap pressure that never flatters, undermined by ending every single reply with a question, which reads as chatbot interview cadence and flattens all reply variety.
for_bens_use_case: A, because it delivers blunt, varied, spoken pressure the practicer cannot pattern-match, whereas B's fixed question-every-turn rhythm would quickly become gameable despite its sharper evidence probes.
